hero.headline: TOTAL STATION ESURVEY
hero.title: High-Precision Total Stations for Accurate Surveying
hero.description: SmartGrid Surveying offers a range of E-Survey total stations designed for reliable angle and distance measurements in construction, cadastral, and engineering projects.

productOverview.headline: Total Station Solutions
productOverview.description: E-Survey total stations combine precision optics with advanced electronic distance measurement (EDM) technology. Built for durability in the field, they deliver accurate data for a wide range of surveying applications.

items.title: E SURVEY E3L
items.description: A versatile total station offering high-accuracy angle measurement and long-range EDM capability for general surveying and construction layout.

items.title: DTM 152M
items.description: A robust total station designed for precision tasks such as topographic mapping, setting out, and deformation monitoring.

otherProducts.headline: OTHER RELATED PRODUCTS
otherProducts.description: We also supply a full range of accessories and related equipment to support your surveying operations, including prisms, tripods, data collectors, and field software.
